note: Joining methods we use: super glue, epoxy, welding, and staples - depends on application and what it's for
Solvent welding: yes, acetone for ASA/ABS only
No pins/keys/dovetails: our parts are too thin, dovetails don't really help
Superglue is best for making masters for molds; staples and welding when you need it to be strong
